name: Word Embeddings
learningObjectives: Understand the concept of word embeddings and distributed representations
Learn how Word2Vec and Skip-gram models work
Explore semantic relationships captured by embeddings
Visualize word embeddings in 2D and 3D space
Apply word embeddings to find similar words

controls.label: Sample Corpus
controls.tooltip: Choose a sample text corpus to train embeddings

controls.label: Embedding Dimension
controls.tooltip: Dimensionality of the word vectors (higher = more expressive but slower)

controls.label: Context Window Size
controls.tooltip: Number of words to consider on each side of the target word

controls.label: Minimum Word Count
controls.tooltip: Minimum frequency for a word to be included in vocabulary

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Step size for gradient updates during training

controls.label: Training Epochs
controls.tooltip: Number of times to iterate through the entire corpus

controls.label: Negative Samples
controls.tooltip: Number of negative samples per positive sample (negative sampling)

visualizations.description: 2D/3D visualization of word vectors showing semantic relationships
